canada.title: 2 pedestrians hospitalized after separate collisions in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Two pedestrians were hospitalized after two separate vehicle collisions in Winnipeg over the weekend, police say.

canada.title: Quebec students consider general strike to protest affordability crisis
canada.summary: Post-secondary students in Montreal gathered on Saturday to vote on an indefinite strike to protest a perceived lack of funding for higher education in Quebec.

canada.title: Will Canadian workers refuse to handle Israeli goods? Why unions increasingly say they should
canada.summary: A movement to cut off Israeli goods is spreading across Canada's unions. The Canadian Labour Congress, which represents more than 3 million workers, passed a resolution last month declaring trade, services and relationships with Israel to be “hot cargo," emphasizing a call for workers to refuse to handle weapons and military equipment destined for Israel.

canada.title: Luxury home sales slump in Toronto, Vancouver, but top-end properties buck trend
canada.summary: It’s been a challenging year for real estate markets across the country, and experts say even typically sought-after high-end properties haven’t been exempt from buyer caution driven by high inflation, trade war anxieties and borrowing cost uncertainties.

canada.title: 'We cannot delay': N.L. scientist observing climate change on 8-month Arctic expedition
canada.summary: Marine Institute Scientist Maxime Geoffroy has a new home for the next five months, and it’s atop a sheet of ice in the Arctic Ocean. He's on a research marathon with a team of 12 that has already seen the effects of climate change before their very eyes.

canada.title: Montreal police arrest 2 ex-officers for alleged assault, criminal harassment, breach of trust
canada.summary: The two officers had previously been placed on administrative leave and then fired from the Montreal police service. They were arrested after Quebec's Crown prosecutor's office issued a warrant.

canada.title: Manitoba government quietly ends court fine work program, then reinstates it after concerns raised
canada.summary: The Manitoba government has reinstated a program that allows people to work off court fines they couldn't otherwise afford to pay, after quietly phasing it out last month.

canada.title: Removal of Baltic III could be nearing completion, coast guard says
canada.summary: Work to remove the MSC Baltic III from the rocks of Cedar Cove could soon near completion, according to the Canadian Coast Guard.

canada.title: How firearms regulations are changing the RCMP Heritage Centre
canada.summary: The RCMP Heritage Centre in Regina, which is set to become Canada's next national museum, has taken out all firearms on display in cases, to comply with provincial firearms regulations. Replica guns should be on display in the new year.

canada.title: 2 teens killed, 1 injured in Scarborough triple shooting
canada.summary: Emergency crews were called to the area of Ellesmere and Brimley Roads just after 12:30 a.m. for reports of three teens who were shot.

canada.title: West Kootenay couple lose business in devastating fire, credit volunteer firefighters with saving their home
canada.summary: A West Kootenay couple is counting their blessings after a massive fire destroyed their home-based mechanic shop in Burton, B.C. — and came dangerously close to taking their house with it.

canada.title: Proposed gondola overlooking Canmore seeks public feedback
canada.summary: A gondola project that has been a contentious topic in Canmore for almost a decade is likely to get a decision in early 2027.

canada.title: New map traces roots of Calgary's 1980s punk rock scene
canada.summary: Calgary may have a reputation for its love of country music, but a new map highlights how important the city’s punk rock scene was in the 1980s.

canada.title: Badly needed construction materials could be rotting outside for years, Nunavut leaders say
canada.summary: Nunavut leaders say building materials for desperately needed homes in their communities are being left unattended for years. Those materials can end up unusable, delaying construction even more

canada.title: Monarch butterfly tagged in N.B. survived fierce challenges before reaching Mexico
canada.summary: After crossing the Bay of Fundy and the Gulf of Maine, and going through a nor’easter and a hurricane, a monarch butterfly weighing less than a gram is closing in on its winter destination in central Mexico.

canada.title: Parole denial for 'chameleon' sex offender by N.Y. board welcomed by Halifax victim
canada.summary: William Shrubsall committed a string of violent sex attacks and other crimes in Halifax in the mid-to-late 1990s and remains imprisoned in New York state. He was extradited from Canada in 2019 to serve prison time there, but because of sentencing guidelines, he was expected to be released before now.

canada.title: Frustrated? Angry? Why these Nova Scotians say you should scream it out
canada.summary: A group of Nova Scotians now meet weekly to scream their frustrations into the ocean. From grocery prices to global instability, they say there's plenty to motivate them these days.

Two teenagers are dead and another is recovering in hospital after a triple shooting in Scarborough that erupted following “a confrontation” between two groups of people Sunday morning, The Canadian Press reports.
The governor of Washington state called U.S. federal immigration agents “out of control” after they arrested two people at Seattle’s main airport on Saturday, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
